checks.text: The dear lot (285) was left alone because selling from it at 270 would lose money (it still has 5 of 5)

shots.caption: An older lot bought at only 5% off: cost 285 a box
Lots after selling one box at a 10% special price

did: Bought an older, dearer lot of 5 boxes (cost 285 each), then sold a box with a 10% special price (270). A lot costing 285 would lose money at 270, so the system should take the box from a cheaper lot.
